name: The Legendary Insect Queen
desc:
2 monsters that mention "Dark Time Wizard", and/or Level 1 EARTH Tokens
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing the above monsters. You can only Special Summon "The Legendary Insect Queen" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 cards that mention "Dark Time Wizard" from your GY and/or banishment to your hand. Your opponent cannot target other cards you control that mention "Dark Time Wizard" with card effects.
